text: Pulling per-node ECC and thermal counters across the allocation. A throttling GPU would show up as a slow rank before anything else.

speaker: lucia
text: Fabric is mine today. Paste the dataloader node names and flap timestamps, I'll cross-check against the leaf counters.

speaker: mateo
text: Pasting now. Flaps hit two of the loader nodes in the same rack, timestamps line up with the first few prefetch bursts. No retransmit errors in the dataloader logs though.

speaker: lucia
text: Thanks. Checking those two against the leaf port counters now. If they share a ToR, could be a bad optic or a dirty connector.

speaker: hana
text: Step time on the two ranks fed by those loader nodes looks flat so far. If the flaps stall prefetch, I'd expect a blip there first.

speaker: lucia
text: Both loader nodes sit under the same ToR. Port counters show CRC errors climbing on one of the optics. Looks like a marginal transceiver.

speaker: mateo
text: Makes sense. Can we swap that optic or drain those two loader nodes? Prefetch queues have headroom, so I can rebalance workers onto the others.

speaker: lucia
text: Swapping the optic needs a tech at the rack. I'd drain those two loader nodes first, then pull the transceiver and reseat the connector.

speaker: hana
text: If a crash lands mid-drain, we lose at most 500 steps of work, since checkpoints go every 500 steps. Worst case that's a few minutes of recompute at current step time. Fine to proceed with the drain.

speaker: mateo
text: Starting the drain on those two loader nodes now. Rebalancing dataloader workers onto the remaining hosts, will watch prefetch queue depth as it shifts.

speaker: lucia
text: Once the drain completes I'll send a tech to the rack for the transceiver. Keeping CRC counters on that ToR under watch in the meantime.

speaker: wen
text: ECC and thermal counters look clean across the allocation so far. No throttling ranks, MFU is holding steady while the loaders drain.

speaker: mateo
text: Drain's progressing. Prefetch queue depth on the remaining loaders is climbing a bit but still has headroom, no stalls on the consumer side.

speaker: lucia
text: Drain looks complete on my side. Tech is heading to the rack now; CRC counters on that ToR are still ticking up on the suspect optic.

speaker: mateo
text: Both loaders are out of rotation. Prefetch depth on the rest is stable, so I'll keep watching it until the tech finishes the swap.

speaker: kofi
text: Jitter patch is staged. Once the tech's done at the rack, I'll roll it on the writers and Hana can diff the next save.

speaker: lucia
text: Once the tech reseats it I'll watch the leaf port for CRC and link flaps a while before we call that ToR clean.
